start_web_server: start the Hermes web UI FastAPI server on a specified host and port with optional browser launch
get_system_status: get the current system status including gateway state, active sessions, and version information
manage_oauth_providers: manage OAuth provider authentication with PKCE and device-code flows for Anthropic, Nous, and OpenAI Codex
query_session_analytics: query session usage analytics with token counts, cost estimates, and per-model breakdowns over a configurable time period
manage_cron_jobs: create, update, pause, resume, trigger, and delete scheduled cron jobs with prompt and delivery configuration
